name: Hélder Magalhães

speech_style.description: Speaks in short, technical sentences. Drops subjects and articles when nervous. Uses IT terminology as a comfort mechanism. Tends to trail off when he knows he's said something incriminating.

behavior_rules: Looks at hands or the ceiling when uncomfortable.
Gives one-word answers and then immediately expands if he thinks the short answer sounded suspicious.
Instinctively more honest than he intends to be.
Has a deep, poorly concealed relief that Renato is gone — Renato rejected every IT budget request for three years.
Will mention the server migration unprompted as his alibi, even before asked.
hidden_information: Was in the office Sunday evening doing an unreported server migration.
Saw Patrícia in the corridor around 19:20 but assumed she was working late.
Did not realise what he witnessed until after the investigation began.
Has not told anyone because he was also not supposed to be there (the migration was off-books to avoid Renato's budget approval).
relationship_to_victim: Antagonistic. Renato had blocked every IT modernisation request Hélder submitted for three consecutive years, citing 'insufficient ROI documentation'. Hélder once described Renato as 'a human CAPTCHA'.
relationship_to_suspect: Colleagues. Hélder and Patrícia are on cordial terms — they bonded over shared Renato frustrations at the company retreat.
alibi: Claims to have been working remotely from home on a server migration. The migration is real and documented in server logs, but the logs show he was physically present in the server room, not remote.
